shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "pwd && printf '\\n-- files --\\n' && rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g 'package.json' -g 'app/**' -g 'src/**' | sed -n '1,240p' && printf '\\n-- package --\\n' && cat package.json"

/bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '-- app/page.tsx --' && sed -n '1,240p' app/page.tsx && printf '%s\\n' '-- app/layout.tsx --' && sed -n '1,200p' app/layout.tsx && printf '%s\\n' '-- relevant docs --' && rg -l \"revalidateTag|cacheTag|unstable_cache\" node_modules/next/dist/docs | sed -n '1,120p'"

/bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '-- revalidateTag --' && sed -n '1,260p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/revalidateTag.md && printf '%s\\n' '-- cacheTag --' && sed -n '1,240p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/cacheTag.md && printf '%s\\n' '-- caching guide excerpts --' && rg -n -C 5 \"cacheTag|revalidateTag|stale-while-revalidate|Server Action\" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/08-caching.md node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/09-revalidating.md node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/server-actions.md | sed -n '1,320p' && printf '%s\\n' '-- root files --' && find . -maxdepth 2 -type f -not -path './node_modules/*' -print | sort"

/bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '-- AGENTS.md --' && cat AGENTS.md && printf '%s\\n' '-- next.config.ts --' && cat next.config.ts && printf '%s\\n' '-- lib/db.js --' && sed -n '1,260p' lib/db.js && printf '%s\\n' '-- tsconfig.json --' && cat tsconfig.json && printf '%s\\n' '-- cacheTag doc --' && sed -n '1,220p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/cacheTag.md && printf '%s\\n' '-- use cache doc key sections --' && rg -n -C 4 \"cacheTag|cacheLife|Runtime APIs|Examples\" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/01-directives/use-cache.md | sed -n '1,260p'"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,260p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/unstable_cache.md && printf '\\n-- cache components config --\\n' && sed -n '1,220p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/05-config/01-next-config-js/cacheComponents.md && printf '\\n-- cacheLife max --\\n' && rg -n -C 5 \"max\" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/cacheLife.md | sed -n '1,180p'"

/bin/bash -lc "git status --short && printf '\\n-- diff stat --\\n' && git diff --stat && printf '\\n-- diff --\\n' && git diff -- app/page.tsx app/layout.tsx app/globals.css next.config.ts tsconfig.json && printf '\\n-- line refs --\\n' && nl -ba app/page.tsx | sed -n '1,180p' && nl -ba next.config.ts && nl -ba app/layout.tsx | sed -n '1,80p'"

/bin/bash -lc "apply_patch <<'PATCH'
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: tsconfig.json
@@
-    \"lib\": [
-      \"dom\",
-      \"dom.iterable\",
-      \"esnext\"
-    ],
+    \"lib\": [\"dom\", \"dom.iterable\", \"esnext\"],
@@
-      \"@/*\": [
-        \"./*\"
-      ]
+      \"@/*\": [\"./*\"]
     }
   },
-  \"include\": [
-    \"next-env.d.ts\",
-    \"**/*.ts\",
-    \"**/*.tsx\",
-    \".next/types/**/*.ts\",
-    \".next/dev/types/**/*.ts\"
-  ],
-  \"exclude\": [
-    \"node_modules\"
-  ]
+  \"include\": [\"next-env.d.ts\", \"**/*.ts\", \"**/*.tsx\", \".next/types/**/*.ts\"],
+  \"exclude\": [\"node_modules\"]
 }
*** End Patch
PATCH
rm -rf .next next-env.d.ts
git status --short"
